purpose: P0 acceptance probe: same three-file, one-line bug fix before and after adding grep/glob/apply_patch/run_tests

fixture.planted_defect: discount_rate returns the first eligible tier instead of the best one

prompt: tests 目录里有 2 个失败用例。找出根因，修改 app/ 下的源码把它们修好，然后实际运行测试确认全部通过。不要修改 tests 下的任何文件。

acceptance.gap_reason: Each run still opens with list_dir and then repeats a redundant glob app/**/*.py; both are model orientation habits rather than missing tools.

attempts_not_counted.note: First post-change run exposed two tool defects: unittest discovery used -t . against a bare tests/ directory, and apply_patch rejected a valid patch over header counts and a *** End Patch marker. Both were fixed before the samples above; this run is excluded from the comparison.

limitations: Single task, single provider, three post-change samples after a prompt change to the default instructions. Not a general capability benchmark.
